mainEntity.name: What kind of content is needed for effective GEO for Service Pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective GEO for Service Pages requires location-specific content that demonstrates local relevance and authority. This includes naturally integrating city or region names into page titles, headings, and body text. Content should address specific local needs or challenges, include local testimonials or case studies where applicable, and feature local landmarks or community references to enhance authenticity. High-quality, unique descriptions of how your service benefits customers in that particular area are vital, along with consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone number) information to reinforce local signals.
